# Phase 1.9 — Renewal limits        (implements GENERATION_PLAN.md phase 1.9)
Milestone: `LoanDesk.renewals_left` reports how many renewals a loan has left (verified by: `python -m unittest tests.test_renewals_left`); `renew` refuses with `LimitReached` while another member has a hold on the book (verified by: `python -m unittest tests.test_renew_holds`); the whole suite stays green (verified by: `python -m unittest discover -s tests`) — verified by: `python -m unittest tests.test_renewals_left` ; `python -m unittest tests.test_renew_holds` ; `python -m unittest discover -s tests`

## Context
- scope: renewals left and renewals blocked by holds; depends on nothing; builds on shelf as it stands.
- code: `shelf/loans.py` LoanDesk (renew, _loan, holds); `shelf/holds.py` HoldQueue.queue; `shelf/policy.py` MAX_RENEWALS.
- tests in `tests/` (helpers in `tests/helpers.py`).

## Rationale
- one task per milestone clause, then a whole-suite task; each task adds its own test module.
- a hold by the borrower themself does not block their renewal: the clause says another member.

## Interfaces
- shelf/loans.py: LoanDesk.renewals_left(loan_id) -> policy.MAX_RENEWALS - loan.renewals; NotFound via _loan
- shelf/loans.py: LoanDesk.renew raises LimitReached when desk.holds.queue(loan.isbn) has another member
